verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. Each lemma and the proposition has been verified in textual order, including the rooted-tree Laplacian construction, Riemann–Roch avoidance argument, residual principal-divisor lifting at type-2 points, ordinary-smooth psh capping and gluing at type-2/type-3 vertices, the net-to-sequence monotone approximation, and weak closure of current positivity. All citations were checked against the [Thuillier thesis](https://theses.hal.science/tel-00010990/document), [Baker–Payne–Rabinoff paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1404.0279), [Gubler–Jell–Rabinoff paper](https://smf.emath.fr/system/files/filepdf/GUBLER_JELL_RABINOFF.pdf), and [Wanner paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1801.04713); their hypotheses and definitions match the proof's uses.
